correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs the relation/operator criterion from singleton input sets, shows a transitive product of equivalences is their join, proves the complete rectangular intersection condition componentwise, and counts labelled surjections modulo free row/column permutations. The exponential formula yields all N_n(a,b,c), and image rank is exactly 2^c. The support inequality n≥Σ_i r_i s_i = a+b-c+Σ_i(r_i-1)(s_i-1) is attained by explicit grids for c=1 and c≥2; arbitrary extra states fit an existing cell. The exact recurrence matches all 44,168 brute candidate ordered pairs for n≤6, including all refined cells, all 255 modal-pair checks n≤4, and 2,025 support cases n≤9; finite checks corroborate rather than prove general claims. The empty case is isolated correctly.

originality.rationale: The finite unrefined commuting-pair total and the composition/join criterion are explicitly earlier knowledge (OEIS A354458). The claimed mathematical difference is a simultaneously three-indexed census, its exact composite modal image-rank distribution and a sharp discontinuous feasibility threshold. The inspected database, primary logical works, and partition-matrix literature do not state or imply this full combination. The canonical all-n proof has been independently reconstructed as a science argument; this originality status is only self-review, with residual translation risk.
residual_risks: A historically equivalent multi-parameter count of permuting congruences or fully nonempty grid partitions could exist under different terminology, especially outside readily searchable text.
No independent specialist review of proof or originality has yet occurred.

Generic labelled combinatorics makes the exponential-formula derivation elementary once the rectangular characterization is known; mathematical value depends on the naturality and completeness of the exact joint rank/support invariant, not on difficulty alone.

value.rationale: The joint distribution of both S5 modality class counts and the size of a composite modal image is a naturally motivated invariant for finite information granularity and successive saturation. Existing OEIS A354458 gives only totals, while the refinement resolves exact ranks and the sharp support dichotomy for one versus multiple merged components. This is a complete invariant census for every n, not an arbitrary small finite slice; the work does not present the previously known marginal or a generic exponential formula as novelty in isolation.
